The seminar serves first- and second-year students together — Cohort A milestones are second-year work, Cohort B first-year. --- ## Session Types - **Workshop** — Facilitated session on the semester's phase topic - **Presentation** — Informal research-in-progress talk - **Milestone** — Formal milestone presentation (Plan of Study, QRP, etc.) - **Student** — Content determined by seminar participants - **Conference** — Conference preparation and presentation practice - **Synthesis** — Semester opening or closing session; reflection and forward planning - **Break** — No seminar (holiday or conference) --- *Schedule subject to change based on student needs and conference dates.*
